name: widdershins
text: widdershins is a variant spelling of withershins, the counterclockwise ritual course. MacKillop records the form as an alternate English spelling used in Scottish dialect. The principal record of the counterclockwise ritual sits under the withershins headword.

attributes.attribute: Variant spelling of withershins; pointer to withershins headword

okr.objective: widdershins is a MacKillop signpost to withershins.
